metas.name: Indonesia  -  (N) Sumatra Palm (Areca)
metas.note:
Areca palms, often called Sumatra palms w/in indo, basically mostly found within Sumatra. probably most often found in western North Sumatra (and the rest of the west coast). west coast of all of sumatra often hilly, North (eastish) coast often flat.

(i have seen them in the nusas, but you probably shouldnt confuse sumatra w/ the nusas)
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.note: bintan is a Batam wannabe. they are basically prepping it to be built up like Batam. So lots of like big buildings with no others around it that seem out of place. Lots of emptiness. click around a little bit and you will get a vibe for it.

metas.note: I found this camera glitch while searching. If you look 90 degrees to the left of the front of the car, there is a glitch that is easier seen when you zoom in fully with a bunch of little lines. in some panos it is more purple aswell. Found within Central Kali on these roads. some parts may have ben ovverrun with newer coverage. It will have 2024 copyright

metas.name: Indonesia  - Central Sula Bollard
metas.note: Central Sulawesi features these unique bollards that are painted black on the bottom, white in the middle, and yellow on the top.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - East Java Pavement
metas.note: East java pavement. mostly around Surabaya. sometimes called surabaya pavement.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - East Java Pole
metas.note: uneven pole, which within Java is most likely east java. The unique poles are the ones that are uneven and the pole continues much higher than the crossbar.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Flat Lombok
metas.note: Within the Nusas(besides Sumba), if it is flat its prolly Lombok
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Flat w/ lone mt. w kali
metas.note: west kali is mostly flat, except for the occasional hill or mountain. so you will often see a flat landscape with one or two hills/mountains near you.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Flores In the Hills/mountains
metas.note: In the Nusas, and you are in the mountains/tall hills, your probably in Flores
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Gorontalo Hills
metas.note: Gorontalo has these unique green hills almost roundish rolling hills. sort of a lack of trees, but there are often some oil palms, often corn growing. click around gorontalo and get a vibe for it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Jambi occasional tiled roof
metas.note: jambi has mostly tin roofs w/ the occasional tiled roof. remember gradient from most to least w/in sumatra goes from south to north.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Java (and bali) antenna
metas.note: Generation 3 antenna coverage is most commonly found on Java, but can very rarely be seen on Bali in and around Denpasar. It is most commonly seen in East Java, as most of the antenna coverage in the west has been overwritten by Generation 4.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Java Rock walls(volcanic)
metas.note: if within Java, and there are these rock walls, (volcanic most likely), and everything feels volcanic, like for ex. dark fields, rocks on the side of the road, etc., you are prolly here.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - JT road
metas.note: most recognizalbe road in Indonesia. Gen 3, really dry, water north.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Kali cut thru forest
metas.note: One way to differentiate Kali from something like Sumatra is that in Kali, most of the roads are like cut through the forest. Everything is bassically on the side of the road again kinda carved into the forest. def more of a vibe
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Kali uneven poles
metas.note: If you are in Kali, and you have uneven poles, you will NOT be in West Kali

metas.name: Indonesia  - Kundur Island soil
metas.note: Kunder island has this orange soil. almost yellowish

metas.name: Indonesia  - Lampung Grid
metas.note: Most of Lampung is in a grid, lots of straight rods, not always North-south tho.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Lampung Individual houses
metas.note: houses are kinda just all on their own. very spread out. the landscape is flat (in the east, west too difficult). lampung architecture is extremely unique. click around and get a feel for it. the houses almost feel more modern to me, often have collums holding up like a small porch in front. often tiled roofs.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Lampung Sticks
metas.note: These sticks on the side of the road are like 100% Lampung 80% of the time. look for other clues cause it could just randomly be like Sulawesi and ur cooked.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Lombok roof
metas.note: unique roof. bell shaped.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Lombok tiles
metas.note: Lombok often has theses really dark, grey even, tiled roofs.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Mahakam River Coal
metas.note: In and around the Mahakam River, you will often see piles of coal being exported.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Malay Border roof curve
metas.note: malaysia has this curve on the edges of the roof sometimes. this is not at all of indo origin, so it is only found in places that border malaysia. So mostly on the east coast of Sumatra, all those islands, and West Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Mamasa Roof
metas.note: very similar to some of the other roofs, but this one the bottom of the roof that is going up is completely straight and not curved.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Mamasa Vibe
metas.note: gen 3 white car, very sunny, can have Mamasa roof, often pines are seen. click around to get a vibe.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Medan Other crops
metas.note: within NS around Medan, you often get other crops in addition to Oil palms, like Corn, Sugarcane, etc. (not often rice). Also most of Medan and surrounding local area is in a North-South Grid
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Muna Island blue houses
metas.note: for some reason Muna Island just has a lot of blue, espcially houses. so if you think u may be in Muna island, and u see blue, its a good clue.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Muna Island Vibe
metas.note: lots of blue, kinda dry idk. click around and get a vibe for it you wont miss it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - N Maluku layered roofs
metas.note: these layered roofs are quite common in N Maluku
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - N maluku porch roofs
metas.note: like extrusions of roof at a slight down angle are common in North maluku.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - N Maluku rock
metas.note: North Maluku often has these piles of rock scattered around and then these gutters and other stuff are sometimes made of rock
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - N Maluku rock house foundation
metas.note: houses on North maluku are often on this rock looking foundation that is a bit off the ground.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - N sula volcanoes
metas.note: north sula has a lot of volcanoes
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Nias plant
metas.note:
This plant is basically everywhere on the island, and is pretty much unique to Nias island within Indonesia. Recognizable red tinted leaves mixed in with the green leaves.

Being part of North Sumatra, they Nias has the NS poles, often made of metal. Nias also often just has random piles of rock on the side of the road.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - North Kali blur
metas.note: most of it is overrun. will be front of the car, in northern north kali. also for more car meta: if its gen 3, you probably shoulndt click kali
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - North sula Nice small roads
metas.note: like West sumatra, North sula has these nice small roads
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - North Sumatra Pole
metas.note: These poles are almost exclusive to North Sumatra. The bar which holds the insulators is even, but features uneven insulators with one on one side and two on the other.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Northern Sula Pole
metas.note: Pole tops in North and Central Sulawesi, and Gorontalo commonly feature an extra attachment right under the horizontal bar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - NS lake landscape
metas.note: Hills are cleared of trees, very green (if there are trees they are replanted, standing on their own, not natural looking). mostly a vibe but nothing else in indo looks like this. Hills with nothing on it exept grass = lake
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - NS lake roof
metas.note:
Around the Lake in North Sumatra you get this roof (central NS). Very boat shaped. can often be found as miniature roofs like on side of the road or on shacks or on top of stuff, etc.

DO NOT confuse it with the West Sumatra roof, that one the ends are steeper and go higher and are "spiky".
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - NS mount sinabung
metas.note: Very distinct Volcano visible from a decently far away around Berastagi. Also in the plateau the crops are different, farming equipment is differnt, often greenhouses, very small fields. overall very different culture from rest of NS.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - NS ugly building
metas.note: block building with no nice things on the side (just concrete). Often above a garage (even if a building is one story, it can often still have a blocky or square feel which is a good clue for NS). Often found in rows, all next to each other This is a good clue for North Sumatra and Sometimes Riau.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Nusa Banana Plant
metas.note: If within the Nusas, u think u might be in Flores, and see banana plants, its prolly east.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Nusa Penida
metas.note: Like Bali, has basically everything bali has, but a bit more dry, has a vibe to the landscape. click around to get a feel for it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Nusa Pole
metas.note: On the Lesser Sunda Islands (“Nusas”), you can find poles with an extra support on the pole top. Sometimes, two supports can be present. The Nusas are very dry.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Palu NSish Ridges
metas.note: The city of Palu in in a roughly north south valley with large mountains on either side.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Pipes to Dumai
metas.note: lots of oil palms in riau. Dumai is the main port so the palm oil is exported through pipes to Dumai. If you see pipes, you think you might be in Riau, your probably around Dumai.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Pontianak Canals
metas.note: Pontianak has a lot of Canals and waterways running through it. good clue for the west coast of Kali overall.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Rante Poa Roof
metas.note: A small region of South Sulawesi, around the city of Rante Pao, features these very unique houses, called Tongkonan, that have saddle-shaped roofs. The houses themselves are also elevated from the ground.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Riau Oil Palms
metas.note: Oil Palms = click Riau basically. Riau has a lot of oil palms.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Riau pole marking
metas.note: within Riau, an oval that says "KJ" in it, w/ blue writing around the oval.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Riau Roof thing
metas.note: This specific Gable Horn (i think thats what its called) is unique to Riau.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - S Kali pole sticker
metas.note: silver reflective thing wrapped around the pole, found in S Kali and the majors roads that lead out of it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - S/C Kali green bridge
metas.note: Green paint can often be seen on the side of bridges in South and Central Kalimantan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - SE Sula grid
metas.note: southeast sula is often in a grid like lampung, can look like lampung at times
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - South Sula Roof
metas.note: this shape of roof with the trinagle and then the flaps coming off the sides at a different angle is extremely common in South Sula. They also often have gable horns. The more unique ones have peices of wood horizontal supporting the top triangle
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - South Sumatra Architecture
metas.note: often tiled roofs, with wooden front of the house. House is kinda elevated off the ground. once you see it you wont unsee it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - South Sumatra Rubber Trees
metas.note: Lots of rubber trees in South sumatra. Ive also seen them in north sumatra though, but should be able to tell the difference w/ other clues w/in Sumatra
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - SS mixed side plantations
metas.note: South Sumatra has terrible land management. so if you feel like the land is being poorly managed, its prolly south sumatra. one effect of this is that there are often mixed types of plantations on each side of the road, or a plantation on one side, and then its wild on the other, etc.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Stereotypical Bali Roofs
metas.note: Tiled roofs, often have a crown, and the things on the corners of the roof also.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sula Fence
metas.note: These painted fences are typically found on Sulawesi. They will be mostly painted white with blue or red.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumatra (southern)  bright tiles
metas.note: very bright tiles tiles mixed in with the "normal" colored tiles. you wont really see this in java. remember theres a gradient of how many roofs are tiled from Lampung to Jambi.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumba Hills
metas.note: If in the Nusas, and are in the hills (not mountains/taller hills like Flores) you are probably in Sumbra, mostly west/south
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumba Roof
metas.note: You can find these distinct roofs with uniquely high-pitched peaks on Sumba.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumba Savannah
metas.note:
Sumba is the only place that has this extremely flat, extremely dry Savannah landscape.

if gen 3, it will be white car
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumbawa Fence
metas.note: Within the Nusas, the Sulawesi style fence is common on the Island of Sumbawa.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Sumbawa inbetween hills
metas.note: most of the coverage in Sumbawa is in between the hills/mountains in the flat areas. So if you are in the Nusas, but in flat area between mountains/hills (you can see them in the distance) you are prolly in Sumbawa.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Timor Roofs
metas.note: these "thatched" roofs are exclusive to Timor. Usually southeast.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Timor white brick
metas.note: If you think u might be on Timor, (very dry, has a distinct vibe cause its the most east), white brick buildings are a good clue for Timor.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Typical North Sumatra
metas.note: Many oil palms, very flat, often straight roads (in grids). (and ofc NS pole)
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - W Kali red dirt
metas.note: west kali sometimes has red dirt.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - W Kali/Maluku pole
metas.note: Even Pole, with the supports coming down directly to the pole at a 45 degree angle. found in North Maluku and West Kali
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - W kali/Maluku pole2
metas.note: Even Pole, with the supports coming down directly to the pole at a 45 degree angle. found in North Maluku and West Kali
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - West Sumatra nice roads
metas.note: Like the richest part of sumatra, the roads are all paved really well, often road lines on smaller roads that usually wouldnt be there.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - West Sumatra Pole
metas.note: symmetrical pole, often metal, has connecting bars that go in at like a 35-40 degree angle from the middle of crossbar to NOT the pole itself, but to little connecting bits. NOT 45 degrees.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - West Sumatra Rice
metas.note: within Sumatra, basically the only place you will see rice is in West Sumatra.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - West Sumatra Steep Roofs
metas.note: West Sumatra features these distinct boat-shaped roofs. the ends go up into a spike unlike the ones in North Sumatra (and south sula)
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: Indonesia  - white w/ green tip sula fence
metas.note: if you see a white w/ green tip sula fence, you are probably on Peleng island. should be 2021copyright as well.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/indonesia for more clues.

metas.name: Indonesia  - Wood Chipping roof
metas.note: On Kalimantan, you can find these unique roofs made out of wooden chips.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/indonesia.

metas.name: north maluku bollard - north maluku bollard
metas.note: this yellow, blue yellow bollard is found in North Maluku. In fact, a lot of stuff in north Maluku is Yellow and blue.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.
